chunks: "Do not face the crescent moon, nor turn your back to it."

key_terms.لَا تَسْتَدْبِرْهُ: do not turn your back to it

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about facing the crescent moon while relieving oneself?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an etiquette-related legal instruction concerning relieving oneself. It prohibits facing the crescent moon or turning one's back to it in that state, reflecting reverence and decorum in bodily acts.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.48 - In another narration, it is stated:
"Do not face the crescent moon, nor turn your back to it (whilst relieving oneself)."
